scenes.purpose: Open on a plain goal so the film starts from work, not from a feature list.
Land the real MiniMax Code workspace at rest so later product statements sit on real product material.
Turn the single goal into ordered steps, each attributed to MiniMax and held long enough to read.
Widen the workflow beyond code with the described media and script capabilities, framed as MiniMax's statement.
Resolve on the single call to action with room to read the label and URL.

treatment.continuity: One real MiniMax Code screenshot carries the middle of the film: a full-workspace landing, then a camera journey from the message input to the suggestion chips. The capability cards reuse the same screenshot as real product material rather than empty frames. Light panel background, dark ink and the interface blue stay constant across all scenes, and each transition overlaps the outgoing scene by its transition length. Every capability line is attributed to MiniMax as a product statement; no measured outcomes, speed, pricing or rankings appear. Asset is internal-eval scope only.
